SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLL-2-FOLD-A-SMOKE-4-.note: The four-row structural form smoke of ROLL-2 proves FORM and nothing else: five custodied Solver samples per row, the plurality-commit replay, zero native task-contract calls, every request fitting. It is scored by no one and read by no one, and under docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md section 3 rule 5 a batch of four rows can never be evidence of benefit.

SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLL-2-FOLD-A-V1.note: ROLL-2 makes no effectiveness claim of its own: it seals a 1,080-row x 5-sample pool on TRAIN Fold A so that commit, selection and verification rules can be read offline at the 0.67 pp floor of docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md section 2d, on the roster where the composed policy will later be flown. Any benefit claim belongs to the read over this pool, which declares its own block.

measurement_design.why_offline_sealed_pool: The measurement instrument note docs/readiness/2026-09-26-slurp-stage3-measurement-instrument-v1.md establishes that a cross-flight contrast at this scale carries a measured +1.87 pp A/A offset (two request-identical flights differed by +1.87 pp SLU with a CI95 excluding zero while intent moved -1.28 pp), so such a contrast needs an in-chain A/A replicate and about 3 pp of effect. The only 0.67 pp instrument the program has is an offline read over one sealed sample pool, and that pool exists on R01C but NOT on the lock roster. This cell creates the missing pool.

files: per_row.json -- one object per row: sample_id, stratum, each of the five samples' official SLU-F1 and scenario_action_exact, the per-row best / worst / delivered scores and the sample-level raw-response digests. Ids, stratum names, sample indices, scores, flags and hashes only.

spread.json -- the within-flight sample spread on Fold A: the pooled paired delta between sample indices with CI95 by paired row bootstrap (10,000 draws, seed 20260915), the byte-identical / intent-flip / entity-set-flip shares and the per-stratum table.
ceiling.json -- the oracle best-of-5 ceiling on Fold A beside the delivered score, stated as an UPPER BOUND that no selection policy can exceed, never as an achieved result.
the per-sample-index outputs copies and their score jsonl, sha256-pinned, written by scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py under the read's own analysis root.
output.privacy: No utterance text, gold label, transcript or model output is printed or persisted by the read's summary files; they carry ids, stratum names, sample indices, scores, flags and hashes only.

roster.stratum_coverage: 18 of 18 SLURP scenarios, 60 rows each -- the full stratified lock roster.

row_accounting_required: 1,080 in, 1,080 out; every row's solver_group carries exactly 5 samples in custody (I7g) with seeds 1249110493, 1249110494, 1249110495, 1249110496, 1249110497 and temperature 0.7 on each; the commit replay of saea-commit-plurality-support-v1 at min_support 3 / similarity 0.8 reproduces the sealed delivered answer for every row; zero native task-contract calls.

stages.1_render: scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --stage render: one outputs COPY per Solver sample index (0..4), each row's solver_group.samples[index].parsed_answer rendered through the canonical analysis path, exactly as cell ROLL-1's own read ran.
stages.2_score: scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --stage score --scorer-id slurp-slu-official-projected-v3-train: each of the five copies scored ONCE through the registered scorer. Never core.scoring_batch (every copy is a derived read, not a manifest score).
stages.3_pairs: scripts/analysis/stage3_rollout_score.py --stage pairs: per-row best / worst and the sealed delivered score, as for cell ROLL-1. This is where the oracle best-of-5 ceiling on Fold A comes from.
stages.4_spread: the within-flight spread read: per row and per sample-index pair, delta_slu and delta_intent, the pooled distributions with CI95 by paired row bootstrap (10,000 draws, seed 20260915), the three flip shares and the per-stratum table. REGISTERED SEPARATELY as run id SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-ROLL-2-FOLD-A-READ-V1 before any number is read.
